descriptions.w3d_d24g_asset_flags_8006ac90: Builds the asset-needed flag table 0x8042e59c: clears 356 bytes, sets entry 5, sets an entry by the mode at +212 (3, 0, 1, or 4); in mode 7 also sets the entry at +3336, reloads Land.Materials when changed, marks every table 0x803f477c entry whose name equals +3344, and marks the kind of each resolved item in 128 groups of six slots at +264. Returns the table.
